name: English
tagline: Post one guard ant in every chamber — never two on a line, never side by side.
clash: That ant breaks a rule — see the red tiles
outOfLivesNote: Three wrong ants ate all three candies — guard this night again.
revealTip: Post one guard for me — costs 2 candy
solved: Solved — nothing left to work out.
noHint: Nothing can be deduced from here — an ant is probably in the wrong place. Try undoing.
hintPlace: Place an ant on the lit tile
hintExclude: These tiles can be switched off — no ant lives there
hintReveal: Here's one more ant, in the only place it fits
hintAroundAnt: This ant's row, column and neighbours can't hold another ant — switch them off
techniqueNotes.1: Some row, column or colour is down to a single cell
techniqueNotes.2: Every option for a colour sits on one line
techniqueNotes.3: K colours fill exactly K lines between them
techniqueNotes.4: A wider lock, or a cell that fails on the spot
techniqueNotes.5: Following an assumption several steps ends in a clash

reasons.regionInLine.row: every option for {0} sits on row {1}, so no other colour can use that row

reasons.setLock.col: {0} colours ({1}) between them fill exactly {0} columns, so no other colour fits there

tut.onePerColour: Every colour posts exactly one guard.
tut.nice: So what does a guard watch?
tut.rowCol: Each ant guards a whole row and column — no one else needs to watch them.
tut.tapToExclude: Tap the cells it watches to switch them off.
tut.adjacent: Guards spread out. They never stand side by side — corners count too.
tut.swipeToExclude: Drag across the cells beside it to switch them off.
tut.adjacentAgain: Same again — guards keep their distance, corners included.
tut.findLast: Where does the last guard go?
tut.tapForHint: Stuck? Tap here for a nudge. 💡
tut.mastered: That's the whole drill. Your first night is waiting.

candyTip: Candy left this level — a wrong ant eats one
candyBankTip: Candy in the store — spent on hints, earned by guarding well
